surfaces.detail: EvidenceSurfaceRuntime request schema has no coverage/snapshot field; initial and per-round coverage are rebuilt from trusted providers through Lane A qualification and the coverage builder. EvidenceEligibilityService materializes authoritative coverage only from a server-owned proceed GuardRunRecord and fails EVIDENCE_LINEAGE_MISSING for any id without a qualified record. A caller-constructed {status:present, verification_level:verified, evidence_ids:[fake]} snapshot can never obtain eligibility (dedicated test).
surfaces.verification: goal24-evidence-runtime.test.ts > initial-coverage attack: caller fake coverage is rejected; goal24-evidence-eligibility.test.ts > a digest-consistent forged guard record with fake evidence ids fails lineage / a forged snapshot with a fabricated guard run id can never materialize; cp6 adversarial oracle CP6V-EXECUTION_BYPASS-001 (COVERED_BY_EXISTING_TEST).

surfaces.detail: The production runtime injects a trusted clock at construction and the request schema rejects now/checked_at/observed time keys. Qualification rejects any candidate observed_at in the future (future_observed_at) and computes staleness from the injected clock, never from caller or provider time.
surfaces.verification: goal24-evidence-runtime.test.ts > future observed_at can never satisfy (trusted clock, never request time); cp6 adversarial oracle CP6V-FUTURE_TIME-001..004, CP6V-FRESHNESS-001/004..008.
